comparison: API_Quantities is a class with a constructor that initializes all four output pointers to nullptr. Prior declaration without braces does not establish uninitialized pointer ownership.

Prior prototype supplied stack API_ElementQuantity and GS::Array<API_CompositeQuantity>; pointers remain alive for the synchronous call. No manual SDK allocation/free occurred. Allocation ownership is not a demonstrated root cause.

Element_Test Do_CalcQuantities uses GetMoreQuantities, an explicit full mask and all four output arrays. Plan_Dump WriteSurfVol uses GetQuantities with type-specific masks and differing parameter choices. These are source examples, not a proven crash fix.

Prior prototype used GetQuantities with default mask, minOpeningSize=0 and a mixed Wall/Slab/Roof/Stair batch. No stage/type record identifies the failing item. Current code does not replay it or substitute masks speculatively.

New GetNativeQuantityPreflightV1 reads element identity/type and emits PRE_ENGINE stage. It never constructs quantity buffers/masks or invokes either quantity API. Existing quantity entry and Python dispatch remain disabled.
